name: The St. Regis Beijing
insider_take: Imperial luxury meets modern sophistication in the heart of China's cultural capital
whats_special: The St. Regis Beijing stands majestically in the prestigious Jianguomenwai district, just minutes from the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square. This palatial property features the world's largest St. Regis Butler Service program and houses the legendary Press Club Bar, a favorite haunt of international journalists and diplomats since the 1980s. The hotel's signature afternoon tea service includes rare Chinese teas sourced from imperial gardens.
pro_tip: Book the Imperial Suite for access to the private terrace with unobstructed views of the Ancient Observatory, one of Beijing's hidden UNESCO gems located directly across the street.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of the vibrant Silk Street Market and the historic Beijing Railway Station. Take advantage of the complimentary Rolls-Royce service to explore nearby Wangfujing pedestrian street, or enjoy the rooftop garden that overlooks the ancient city walls—a perfect sunset spot after touring the Temple of Heaven.
pros: Legendary St. Regis Butler Service available 24/7
Prime location in Chaoyang District near business centers and shopping
Spacious luxury suites with premium amenities and city views
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
